articles.title: Quantum Alliance forms amid warnings 6.4 million bitcoin face future quantum threat
articles.snippet: Nine crypto companies launched the Quantum Alliance to jointly prepare for quantum attacks, but they disagree on when the threat will arrive and whether vulnerable BTC should be frozen.

articles.title: Tokenized Tesla surges as Elon Musk unveils SpaceX-powered flying Roadster prototype
articles.snippet: Volume in Hyperliquid’s Tesla contract hit $47 million in one hour after Elon Musk’s flying Roadster demo, up from $2.8 million, with U.S. stocks closed.

articles.title: Live updates: Crypto gives up more ground as AI selloff picks up steam
articles.snippet: A Friday surge in oil prices is hitting already-shaky equity markets, sending the Nasdaq down more than 2%.

articles.title: MSCI approves rules that could eject Strategy, Metaplanet from equity indexes
articles.snippet: The rules proposed in August would see companies that exist mainly to hold investments as no longer eligible for index inclusion.

articles.title: An OpenAI agent ran out of Ethereum funds, and took from a wallet it did not own
articles.snippet: The research model derived funded Sepolia addresses from public seed phrases, questioned whether using the money was ethical, then called the funds “effectively abandoned” and used them anyway.
